name: Starter Pack
look: A plain white square divided by a thick black cross: a horizontal line runs edge to edge and a shorter vertical line crosses it in the middle, leaving four empty sections for pictures.
use: A title reading "The ___ Starter Pack" goes on top, and each section gets a picture or label of an item, outfit or habit that sums up a stereotype of some kind of person, place or hobby.
examples: The first day of a new diet starter pack
describe: blank template split into four boxes for a stereotype collage
white square with a black cross dividing it into quarters
empty grid for pictures of things a type of person always has
collage of typical items that define a stereotype with a title
four section layout for listing the essentials of a group
